experiments.scope: Organizer-executed replay of the 92 two-block 31-step collisions found by the pre-registered runs (trial t < 92 returns pair t: E-C, then the 91 E-S successes in key order; t < 16 are the certificates; M1' = M1 + DW, DW nonzero only in second-block words 5..9), plus, on every trial, the counted 7-lane x 36-bit SWAR early-abort batch of the online phase on 16 random 256-bit words derived from the organizer's trial seed, compared lane by lane with a scalar 31-step compression. Trials 92..255 return no pair by design. No probability, rate or cost inference: the success rate H-SUCC rests on the participant runs in the proof (Section 3, Appendix A), not on this experiment.
experiments.hypothesis: All 92 returned pairs are distinct messages with equal sha256-r31-prefix-v1 digests and share the single difference DW5..9 = (00000ffa, 001f77ef, b00fb5fa, d800f100, 00008004). On every trial the SWAR batch executes exactly 2,235 counted primitives (rand 16, load 47, add 263, and 792, or 246, xor 308, shift 543, cmp 7, branch 13) using 55 of the 64 registers, and all 7 lanes' key (CV word 0) and full chaining value equal the scalar compression of the same lane block.
